item.title: Charli xcx Shares Pop-Punk Track ‘Playboy Bunny’ as B-Side to ‘SS26’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. Charli XCX is back with new music, and we're excited to dive in.
Charli XCX has just shared a new track called "Playboy Bunny", the B-side to her recently released song "SS26". The pop-punk track comes with a minimalist black-and-white music video, which was shot in Paris. In the video, Charli sports a ponytail, a white jacket, and black pants as she strolls through the streets of Paris, poses in front of the Eiffel Tower, and walks through crowded streets.
[Clip of "Playboy Bunny" plays]
Host: The song features Charli singing over a fast-paced guitar riff, with lyrics that showcase her signature style. The "Playboy Bunny" video is currently only available on Instagram, and the song will be included on a limited-edition 7-inch vinyl for "SS26".
Charli XCX has also been sharing insights into her creative process, explaining that her B-sides are paired with specific songs because they offer a contrasting sound. She notes that "Playboy Bunny" is a great example of this, with sonic elements that are opposite to "SS26".
[Clip of Charli XCX speaking plays]
Host: Charli has also mentioned that her B-sides won't be available on streaming platforms, at least for now. This is part of her strategy to create unique experiences for her fans.
Charli XCX has been making waves with her recent releases, including "Rock Music" and "SS26", which will both be included on her upcoming seventh studio album. The album doesn't have a title or release date yet, but we're excited to see what's next from this talented artist.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for now. Check out Charli XCX's "Playboy Bunny" on Instagram, and stay tuned for more music updates. Thanks for listening!
